paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 4 clubs across 3 levels, with Alejandro Garza producing the night's most notable performance.
Alejandro Garza drove in 1 run with a sacrifice fly in the seventh to right field on a 2-2 pitch from Yereny Teus.
Alejandro Garza drove in 1 run with a single in the eighth to left field on a 1-1 pitch from Trendan Parish.
He batted second and started at second base.
Hill City Howlers fell to Charleston RiverDogs, 7-10.

Ryan Tayman went 1-for-2, 1 RBI, 1 walk for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. Ryan Tayman drove in his lone run with a sacrifice fly in the fourth to deep center field on a first-pitch 80 mph changeup from Caleb Leys. He batted fourth and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets fell to Lakeland Flying Tigers, 1-10.
Brooks Lee went 1-for-3 for Minnesota Twins. He batted seventh and started at third base. Minnesota Twins beat Atlanta Braves, 4-1.

Bryce Warrecker came on in relief for Hudson Valley Renegades in the bottom of the fourth with two outs. He worked 1 1/3 innings, allowing 3 hits and 1 earned run, striking out 1 without issuing a walk. One of his strikeouts came in the fifth on a 3-2 pitch, when he put away Robert Phelps. Hudson Valley Renegades beat Jersey Shore BlueClaws, 10-5.
title: Alejandro Garza highlights a busy Tuesday for former Mustangs
